## `M:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExList`1.HandleCentralValueCommander(System.String,System.Boolean)`

```text
protected void MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExList<T>.HandleCentralValueCommander(string changedValueType, bool updateStyles = true)
```

CentralCommander has a simple aim: Prevent racing conditions. It has two mechanism to do this:
    (1) When this method is running, it doesn't allow to run a second one. That guarantees to different value parameters can not call this method at the same time.
    (2) When this method runs once, prevents all value setters until OnAfterRender runs. That guarantees to have proper values.

## `M:MudBlazor.Extensions.Core.MudExCronSchedule.IsValid(System.String)`

```text
public static bool MudBlazor.Extensions.Core.MudExCronSchedule.IsValid(string expression)
```

Five fields (minute hour day month weekday) or six with seconds first. Every field is a comma separated list of
    *, a value, or a range a-b (a <= b), each optionally followed by /step (1 up to the field's maximum).
    Values are numbers within the field's range, or names: JAN-DEC for the month, SUN-SAT for the weekday (Sunday is 0 or 7).
    Day and weekday also allow ?. Quartz/Jenkins style extensions are accepted where cron allows them:
    L and nW for the day of the month, nL and n#k (k = 1-5) for the weekday. Nothing else, so typos like FUNDAY or 1- are invalid.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Core/MudExCronSchedule.cs:66](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Core/MudExCronSchedule.cs#L66) · Evidence: source-declaration

```text
public static IReadOnlySet<(uint Shape, int? Paragraph)> MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Presentation.SlideBuildSteps.InitiallyHidden(Slide slide)
```


Reads delimited text into a workbook with one sheet. The encoding comes from the byte order mark, else UTF-8 if the bytes
    are valid UTF-8, else Windows-1252. Plain numbers with a dot as decimal separator are read as numbers; other fields are
    converted like typed input in  (dates, percentages, currency).

## `M:MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsReader.Read(Stream)`

```text
public static Workbook MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsReader.Read(Stream stream)
```

Reads the cell values of every sheet with their number formats, plus sheet names and visibility. Formulas, other
    styles and layout are not read; formula cells keep their last calculated value.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsReader.cs:15](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsReader.cs#L15) · Evidence: source-declaration

## `M:MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsxReader.Read(Stream)`

```text
public static Workbook MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsxReader.Read(Stream stream)
```

Reads a workbook: sheets with names, visibility and tab colors, defined names, cell values, formulas (shared formulas
    expanded per cell, array formulas spilling from their first cell) with their cached results, styles, column widths, row
    heights, hidden rows and columns, merged ranges and frozen panes. The workbook keeps the source package so parts and
    worksheet content the model does not represent survive saving.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsxReader.cs:20](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsxReader.cs#L20) · Evidence: source-declaration

## `M:MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsxWriter.Write(Workbook,Stream)`

```text
public static void MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.XlsxWriter.Write(Workbook wb, Stream target)
```

Writes the workbook. A workbook read by  is written surgically: workbook.xml, the worksheets,
    shared strings and styles are regenerated (keeping worksheet content, attributes and styles the model does not represent),
    the calculation chain is removed, and every other part of the source package is copied unchanged, so macros, pivot
    tables, drawings and custom XML survive and a macro-enabled workbook stays macro-enabled. Any other workbook is written as a
    minimal package without a theme. Formulas are written with their calculated values; Excel does not recalculate on open.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsxWriter.cs:28](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Io/XlsxWriter.cs#L28) · Evidence: source-declaration

## `P:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExFileDisplayZip.HandleContentErrorFunc`

```text
public Func<IMudExFileDisplayInfos, Task<MudExFileDisplayContentErrorResult>> MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExFileDisplayZip.HandleContentErrorFunc { get; set; }
```

A function to handle content error.

```text
public bool MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExRibbon.EnableKeyTips { get; set; }
```

Whether pressing and releasing Alt shows key tips: letters over the tabs and, after a tab is chosen, over its commands.
    Tips come from  and  or are assigned from the text,
    the file tab uses "F".
    Alt is handled while the focus is inside the ribbon. While the focus is elsewhere, only the first ribbon on the page reacts, and only when
    it is the only ribbon or nothing is focused; focus inside a modal dialog that does not contain the ribbon is always ignored.

```text
public bool MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExUploadEdit<T>.RestrictArchiveContent { get; set; }
```

Defines whether the files inside an archive are subject to the  and
     restrictions as well.
    When false (the default) only the archive itself is checked, so an allowed zip may contain anything.
    When true an allowed archive is opened and rejected as a whole as soon as one file inside it violates
    the restrictions - useful when zip is allowed as a container but its payload still has to be controlled.

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExNotebookCanvas`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExNotebookCanvas
```

The editing surface of the notebook editor: shows a page with a selection layer above it. In the text tool a click on the free page starts a new
    text block there and a click into a text block edits it; elements are selected, moved and resized with the pointer. The gestures run in the
    browser and only their result reaches .NET as one undo step. The keyboard nudges, deletes, duplicates and cycles through the elements; Tab past
    the last element leaves the surface. The canvas does not listen to : a host that changes the
    notebook itself renders the canvas again.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Components/Notebook/MudExNotebookCanvas.razor.cs:18](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Components/Notebook/MudExNotebookCanvas.razor.cs#L18) · Evidence: source-declaration

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExSlideCanvas`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExSlideCanvas
```

The editing area of the slide editor: shows a slide at a zoom level with a selection layer above it.
    Shapes are selected, moved, resized and rotated with the pointer, with smart guides while moving; the gestures run in the browser
    and only their result reaches .NET as one undo step. The keyboard nudges, deletes, duplicates and cycles through the shapes; Tab past the
    last shape leaves the canvas. The canvas does not listen to : a host that changes the
    presentation itself renders the canvas again.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Components/Slides/MudExSlideCanvas.razor.cs:18](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Components/Slides/MudExSlideCanvas.razor.cs#L18) · Evidence: source-declaration

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExSpreadsheetGrid`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.MudExSpreadsheetGrid
```

Virtualized spreadsheet grid for one worksheet of a : renders only the visible cells plus a
    buffer, supports Excel-style selection, keyboard navigation, in-cell editing, clipboard, fill and resizing. All edits go
    through workbook commands and can be undone. Pointer drags, resizing and filling run in the browser; only their results
    reach .NET, so the grid stays responsive in Blazor Server.

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.SlideImageUrls`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Components.SlideImageUrls
```

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.CalcEngine`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.CalcEngine
```

Calculates the formulas of a workbook and keeps their results in . Cell edits recalculate only
    the dependent cells in dependency order. Inserting or deleting rows or columns, adding, removing or renaming a sheet and
    changing defined names recalculate only the formulas whose result can change (and their dependents); formulas whose
    references just moved along keep their value. Parsed formulas are cached by their text. Cells on a
    circular reference get . Formulas that cannot be evaluated here (unknown functions or syntax the
    parser does not support) keep the value they had when the engine attached or the graph was rebuilt, together with the cells of
    their array result, until the formula itself is edited. Array results spill into the cells below and to the right, which
    then hold computed values with  set; a non-empty cell in the way yields .
    Formulas calling volatile functions recalculate on every calculation. A formula that fails unexpectedly yields .
    Dispose the engine to stop following the workbook.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Calc/CalcEngine.cs:25](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Calc/CalcEngine.cs#L25) · Evidence: source-declaration

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.ConditionalFormatEvaluator
```

Evaluates the conditional formatting of a sheet cell by cell, so a grid only pays for the cells it shows. Aggregates (minimum, maximum,
    percentiles, ranks, averages, duplicate counts) are computed once per rule and kept until  fires or
     is called. Evaluation never changes the workbook or the calculation engine. Dispose the evaluator to stop
    following the workbook.

## `T:MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.SortCommand`

```text
MudBlazor.Extensions.Office.Spreadsheet.SortCommand
```

Sorts the rows of a range in a stable way, in Excel order: numbers, text, booleans, errors, and blank cells last (also when descending).
    Values, formulas (moved relatively, as when copying), styles, row heights, notes and single-row links move with their rows. Like Excel, hidden
    and filtered rows stay in place and only the visible rows are reordered among themselves; ranges that intersect merged cells are refused.
    Sorting inside the auto filter range records the first key as the filter's sort.

Source: [MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Commands/SortCommand.cs:15](https://github.com/fgilde/MudBlazor.Extensions/blob/ddc7472ecb8674a8f151e94a1d334b204f4916c7/MudBlazor.Extensions/Office/Spreadsheet/Commands/SortCommand.cs#L15) · Evidence: source-declaration
